doc: Naive sketch: 'own Kernel on the locking ring with no free inner neighbour, no R1/R2 kill, enemy Kernel off the ring -> loss'; 'enemy Kernel on the ring, ours off -> win'. Colour-blind.

+ exact escape with the actions left (E1; E2 vacate-then-step; E3 ring-step-then-in), + colour asymmetry: shrink after Magenta's turn, both burning -> Magenta. LOSS_C ignores where Magenta's Kernel is; WIN only for Magenta to move (Cyan gets no turn).

+ sound own-turn no-kill (adds R3x one-blocker rays, >=2 guards), + bare-Kernel safety: LOSS_C needs a non-losing Magenta reply (Cyan non-Kernels not in {1,2}, or Magenta Kernel keeps >= a+1 empty neighbours -> step out and back), WIN_M needs a capture-free line (quiet move, or Cyan non-Kernels not in [1,a]); positions with only Kernels are left to the endgame wrapper.

+ WIN_C2: Cyan to move with 2 actions 'passes' (a quiet move and back restores the board), then Magenta's Kernel is doomed exactly like LOSS_M seen from Magenta (no escape in 2, no kill in 2, Cyan's Kernel off the ring).

+ WIN_C: Cyan to move (1 or 2 actions) wins when an explicit plan -- pass (2 actions), one Kernel step (1 action) or two Kernel steps (2 actions) onto empty squares -- leaves Magenta's Kernel doomed (on the ring, no escape in 2, no kill in 2, Cyan's Kernel off the ring).

+ LOSS_CK (Kernel squeeze): Cyan to move whose only legal actions are Kernel steps; every Kernel plan ends on the locking ring (burns), or in a bare-Kernel loss, or on a square where Magenta's sound kill rules R1/R2 fire -> certified loss (firewall + tactics).

Exactness pass. escape_x: under no-kill an action onto the enemy Kernel never moves ours (exact escape). LOSS_C6 = LOSS_C(escape_x) | a=1 full squeeze (every legal Cyan action -> bare loss, sound Magenta kill R1/R2, or Kernel burns with a non-losing Magenta reply) | a=2 Kernel-only squeeze with redirected attacks (guard removal in sacrifice order). LOSS_M6 with escape_x. WIN_M6: any Magenta line avoiding bare Kernels within distance 2 (quiet, capture-and-return, sound kill, count, far Kernels). WIN_C6: plans with escape_x.

+ full two-action squeeze for Cyan: every legal pair of Cyan actions (any pieces; the second action generated on the board after the first) ends in a bare-Kernel loss, a sound Magenta kill (R1/R2), or the Cyan Kernel burning with a non-losing Magenta reply. Prefilter: all Kernel-only plans lose (necessary).
Tier 1 only (pure fixed shift operations, no enumeration): LOSS_C core with escape_x, LOSS_M, WIN_M of gen6.
Final = final.certify (gen7 logic): unions WIN / LOSS and parts.
120k synthetic positions (shrink/boxed/sparse), oracle run on every flagged one

hunt_5_violations.npz: round 24, Cyan Kernel boxed in the 4x4 corner, Magenta Kernel unguarded; Cyan Exploit jumps off the Trace diagonal -> discovered Trace shot kills (R1/R2 miss it). gen1 claims LOSS_C, true value +1; caught by R3x in gen2+.
